chunks.content: The synthetic recovery target is four hours.
The synthetic operations team owns the incident runbook.
The deployment incident is identified as INC-1042.
The backup policy is documented in synthetic-backup-policy.md.
The change approval rule requires a designated change approver for every synthetic change.
Service outages use the #synthetic-escalation channel.
Synthetic diagnostic logs have a retention period of 30 days.
The database migration required for vectors is 0002_add_pgvector.
KB_7 describes synthetic knowledge-base onboarding.
Only a delegated synthetic change approver may approve a destructive action.
The incident communication cadence is one update every 30 minutes.
The synthetic payments service has the recovery objective.
The release checklist is stored in synthetic-release-checklist.md.
On a provider timeout, the fallback procedure returns the insufficient-information response.
Synthetic-oncall-handover.md covers the on-call handover procedure.
The maximum RAG context source count is five; this chunk also describes token limits of 1500 estimated tokens.
Synthetic-rollback-runbook.md explains the rollback procedure.
The policy for unsupported claims is to reject them and return the insufficient-information answer.
The access request identifier is ACCESS-091.
The safe error response policy returns stable public messages and conceals internal details.
Citation excerpts are derived from an exact sentence in selected source evidence.
Hybrid retrieval candidates are ranked by reciprocal-rank-fusion score.
Only synthetic or explicitly public content is allowed before authorization exists.
The embedding batch boundary is an atomic bounded batch of approved chunks.
EKAA_RAG_MIN_EVIDENCE_SCORE defines the RAG evidence threshold.
The rule for duplicate ingestion is that a duplicate document checksum creates no new synthetic chunks.
CitationValidator enforces citation validation against selected evidence.
The observability policy requires sanitized correlation, traces, and metrics.
Secrets must never enter logs.
The prompt-injection policy is recorded in synthetic-safety-policy.md.
Insufficient evidence returns: Insufficient information is available in the knowledge base.
EKAA_HYBRID_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED=true enables hybrid retrieval.
A reranking provider failure falls back to the original stable order.
The reranker candidate limit is 12.
A citation source includes document ID, document name, chunk ID, page, and section.
The policy for malformed provider output is to reject it with a safe RAG output error.
Lexical search obtains candidates from PostgreSQL full-text search.
The test database requirement is a disposable PostgreSQL URL with pgvector.
Synthetic-security-review.md contains the security review process.
Data minimization sends and retains only content needed for the use case.
An action approval is bound to the exact action and validated parameters.
The source policy for golden data permits synthetic or public content only.
This baseline evaluates the versioned synthetic corpus.
MRR measures the reciprocal rank of the first expected result.
Recall at K is the fraction of expected chunks in the first unique ranked K results.
The failure-rate denominator is every reviewed evaluation question.
Estimated cost is unavailable without a versioned provider price schedule.
Correctness, faithfulness, and citation accuracy require human calibration.
